{"id":"eb5e993f-ce87-4d6a-a943-f4857a85abe6","object":"chat.completion","created":1790480463,"model":"deepseek-flash","choices":[{"index":0,"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"{"supported_by": ["C1"], "missing": "No Verified Claim establishes the existence or identity of a journal article by Alka Marwaha, its topic similarity to The Secret World of Vipassana and Mathematics, or its publication six years after that book (around 2022).", "evidence_needed": "Bibliographic or publication-record evidence identifying a journal article authored by Alka Marwaha, including title, journal, publication date, and topic, sufficient to show an article on a similar topic published about six years after 2016, or a comprehensive publication list/author record sufficient to establish that no such article exists."}","reasoning_content":"We need answer JSON only. Need assess evidence gap for Local Obligation. Need compare required evidence with Verified Claims. Local Obligation: "Establish and identify a journal article by Alka Marwaha on a topic similar to her book The Secret World of Vipassana and Mathematics, published six years after that book, including whether such an article exists."

Verified claims:
C1: Alka Marwaha is associate professor Math at Jesus and Mary College, author of The Secret World of Vipassana and Mathematics (Wisdom Tree Publishers, November 15, 2016), book exploring singularity between Vipassana and Mathematics.
C2: Awarded Commonwealth Scholarship to pursue PhD in Math at Dalhousie, also Izaak Walton Killam Scholarship.

Need identify which claims support relevant parts: C1 establishes Alka Marwaha, book, date 2016, topic. C2 irrelevant to journal article? It establishes Alka Marwaha's academic background but not article. Could support identity? It mentions Alka Marwaha, same person likely. But not article. The obligation requires journal article by Alka Marwaha on similar topic published six years after book (i.e., around 2022). No claim states any journal article. So missing: existence/identity of such journal article by Alka Marwaha, topic similar to book, publication six years after book (2022). Evidence needed: bibliographic record or publication evidence of a journal article authored by Alka Marwaha, with title/topic, journal, publication date around 2022 (six years after 2016), establishing existence. Need be careful: "whether such an article exists" includes negative? But missing is evidence of article existence or absence? The Local Obligation is to establish/identify article including whether exists. Claims don't mention any article. So missing: any evidence of a journal article by Alka Marwaha published ~2022 on Vipassana/Mathematics. Evidence needed: bibliographic citation or authoritative publication record indicating title, author, journal, date, topic. Since the obligation includes "whether such an article exists", evidence could be comprehensive publication list or bibliographic database search showing either existence or absence. But don't output search query. Sufficient evidence signature: publication record/bibliographic metadata (title, author, journal, date, topic) or comprehensive publication list establishing presence/absence. Must not require downstream attributes if entity not established. But here the entity is the article; if not identified, missing is existence/identifying evidence. The evidence needed describes type. Supported_by: C1 maybe C1 only. C2? C2 supports Alka Marwaha's identity as scholar but not directly relevant to journal article? It may support identity of same Alka Marwaha? The Local Obligation concerns author Alka Marwaha. C2 states Alka Marwaha awarded scholarship, same name, but does it support author? It doesn't link to book. C1 explicitly author and book. C2 is about Alka Marwaha's academic background but not article. It could support that Alka Marwaha is a Mathematics academic, relevant to topic? But not article. Since supported_by should list claims actually supporting relevant parts. C1 supports author/book/date/topic. C2 supports Alka Marwaha identity? It doesn't state she is author. But it says Alka Marwaha was awarded scholarship; same name. Could be relevant to identifying Alka Marwaha as academic, but not directly article. The obligation requires article by Alka Marwaha. C2 helps establish she is a math scholar, but not that she wrote article. However, C1 already establishes author. I'd include C1 only, maybe C2 irrelevant. Need decide. The instructions: which Claims actually support relevant parts of obligation. C2 does not support article existence, topic, date. It supports Alka Marwaha's identity as a Mathematics scholar, which is a relevant part? The obligation is about an article by Alka Marwaha; identity of Alka Marwaha is relevant. C1 already gives identity. C2 gives additional identity but not necessary. It might support the author's academic identity. But "support relevant parts" maybe C1 and C2? C2: "Alka Marwaha was awarded..." This confirms an Alka Marwaha in mathematics, but not the same as author? It uses same name, no link to book. It doesn't say "author Alka Marwaha". It could be same person but claim doesn't state link. Rule 3: supports only entity etc it states. C2 states Alka Marwaha (entity) awarded scholarship. It doesn't state she is author of book. So cannot transfer. But the obligation's author Alka Marwaha may be same entity. However, C2 doesn't establish she is the author. So perhaps C2 does not support relevant part except name. C1 is direct. I'd put supported_by ["C1"].

Missing: "No Verified Claim establishes the existence or identity of any journal article by Alka Marwaha, nor its publication six years after The Secret World of Vipassana and Mathematics (i.e., around 2022), nor its topic similarity to that book." That's specific.

Evidence_needed: "Bibliographic or publication-record evidence (e.g., a journal article citation with author, title, journal, publication date, and topic) showing an article by Alka Marwaha published about six years after 2016, or a comprehensive publication list/author record sufficient to establish that no such article exists." But rule says don't output search query. This is evidence signature. Could mention authoritative bibliography. Ensure not specific website. Good.

Need JSON only. Final with schema."},"logprobs":null,"finish_reason":"stop"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":790,"completion_tokens":1337,"total_tokens":2127,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":640},"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":1204},"prompt_cache_hit_tokens":640,"prompt_cache_miss_tokens":150},"system_fingerprint":"aeb56401ca74e127821c4f9126dcb669"}
